channel.title: Kisi incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Kisi's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Delay in processing events [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 22:45 UTC on September 3 and 00:35 UTC on September 4, Marketplace event processing was delayed due to an interruption at our cloud provider. Processing has returned to normal. We regret the inconvenience.

item.title: Cisco Meraki Snapshot API Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Cisco Meraki Snapshots are working normally again. We have a backlog but it will be cleared in sometime.

item.title: Mindbody integration issue [resolved]
item.description: Mindbody team has confirmed that they have fixed the issue. Daily sync should proceed as usual. If you notice any issues, please reach out to Kisi Support team.

item.title: VORTEX Tailgating feature is experiencing issues [resolved]
Failing video exports for VORTEX cameras [resolved]
Video exports are failing for VORTEX cameras [resolved]
Delayed hardware configuration synchronization [resolved]
item.description: Between 13:10 and 16:50 UTC, customers may have experienced a delay in synchronization of reader, controller and door configurations from the cloud to the devices. The issue has since been resolved. All device configurations are now up-to-date.
